Vendor.description: Google Play Billing permission. Since Google Play Billing Library 1.0 the permission is embedded in the library manifest, so it is not necessary to add it to the app manifest.

Google Play services messaging permission (C2DM / GCM / FCM). No current Android reference page documents it; it is listed so manifests that declare it, or remove it with tools:node="remove", are shown as they are.

Google Play services normal permission that apps targeting Android 13 (API 33) or above must declare to use the advertising ID. SDKs such as the Google Mobile Ads SDK (play-services-ads) declare it in their library manifest, so it is merged into the app unless the app removes it with tools:node="remove".
Vendor.playPolicy: Play Console asks whether the app uses the advertising ID; apps that do not should remove this permission from the merged manifest.

Other.description: Allows a calling app to continue a call which was started in another app. An example is a video calling app that wants to continue a voice call on the user's mobile network. When the handover of a call from one app to another takes place, there are two devices which are involved in the handover; the initiating and receiving devices.
